title: Where to Go in Lisbon
abstract: Locals and in-the-know travelers head to Intendente, a historic district in Portugal’s capital city that has undergone a dramatic makeover.

title: Where to Go in Manila
abstract: Escolta, once the Philippines’ version of Fifth Avenue, is being revived by young artists and historic preservationists.

title: Where to Go in Beirut
abstract: Bistros, bars and cafes in the Badaro section beckon residents to forget their daily troubles.
